recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11134; later whitespace/type-related linkId questions should remain tracked under their own issue keys.
issue_request: FHIR-11134 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PC issue raised against DSTU2. It requested retaining the linkId name, changing Questionnaire.item.linkId's short definition to "unique id for item in questionnaire", changing QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId's short definition to "Pointer to specific item from Questionnaire", and making both linkId elements 1..1.
initial_application: Git commit 76675fcc91938801ee4e8de9ec10d2c6e1949bc8 on 2016-11-15 explicitly mentioned #11134 and changed the legacy Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse spreadsheet sources from 0..1 to 1..1 with the requested short names. Subsequent source refactors carried those definitions into the current StructureDefinition XML files.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists questionnaire and questionnaireresponse as active resources. Later linkId issues such as FHIR-38654 and FHIR-46191 added whitespace and validation guidance without reversing FHIR-11134's purpose or cardinality; FHIR-46191 is already represented on the combined branch. Direct FHIR-11134 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The current source has Questionnaire.item.linkId with short "Unique id for item in questionnaire" and min/max 1..1, and QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId with short "Pointer to specific item from Questionnaire" and min/max 1..1.
